plan_review.notes: Adopted: authoritative per-step player-attributed kill count instead of SessionRecorder totalKills (count-delta inference); robust one-shot acknowledgement incl. touch pointers with an arm delay so the stair-confirm Enter cannot instantly dismiss; scope the summary to transition_to_next_floor only (terminal victory opens the run survey); world.elapsedMs for floor time; goldLedger for gold earned this floor (playerGold carries over); current/max HP for health; explicit undefined-vs-zero handling; update the two existing floor-transition e2e tests to acknowledge the summary.

rounds.notes: Medium finding: the auto-driven timed advance was covered only by a source-string guard. Fixed by adding a probe seam (setAutoDrivenForProbe) and a deterministic e2e case that completes Floor 1 with isAutoDriven() true and asserts the scene reaches Floor 2 with no acknowledgement.
Re-review of the auto-driven coverage fix: no remaining concerns across correctness, determinism, layering, security, performance, and regression coverage.

independent_grade.notes: The PR correctly implements the between-floor summary screen, properly handling both human and AI-driven runs without breaking the loop or hanging. It correctly tracks floor kills per simulation step to avoid double-counting, provides complete deterministic test coverage including e2e timeout and acknowledge testing, and respects the required determinism and layer boundary policies.
